title: Deviation: MisraC2012-2.2 magic numbers in CAN_ConfigureRxMailboxesForExtendedIdentifiers, copied from the TI HALCoGen generated configuration (can.c)

standards_mappings.reference: Part 6 Clause 8 / Part 11 Clause 8 (coding guidelines and their justified deviations)
standards_mappings.rationale: The project states a MUST for MISRA C:2012 compatibility (docs/developer-manual/software/software-programming-language.rst:22), so these suppressions are deviations from a stated coding-guideline expectation. deviation_rationale: Content copied from HALCoGen generated configuration file
review_disposition_note: The function opens four suppression families on consecutive lines (278-281): Generic-NoMagicNumbers, MisraC2012-2.2, IISB-LiteralSuffixesCheck and Generic-NoEmptyLoops, and closes the same four in the same order at lines 561-564. Only MisraC2012-2.2 is in the MISRA rule set, so this record carries that rule and lists the other three as co-located non-MISRA checks. No approval or waiver artifact for the vendored block was found in the repository. Governance evidence search at the pinned baseline: no deviance log, deviation log, suppression register, waiver file or review record for the MisraC2012 style checks exists anywhere in the repository (searched for *deviance*, *deviation*, *misra*, *axivion* file names and for 'AXIVION' across docs/). docs/tools/static-analysis/ and conf/spa/ do not exist at this commit. The rationale text below is therefore the only recorded justification.
reanalysis_justification: This is the highest-risk suppression in the set: it disables four check families over roughly 280 lines of raw hardware-register writes for CAN1 mailboxes 42, 61, 62, 63 and 64. It must be re-analysed on every HALCoGen re-generation, on any mailbox renumbering, and on any change of the TI Hercules CAN driver register map, because a stale block silently reverts mailbox configuration while still reporting no violation. The recorded provenance (HL_can.c, 11-Dec-2018, version 04.07.01) should be pinned in a configuration-managed baseline rather than in a source comment.

design_traceability.coverage_note: can.c is not in the implementation_mapping of any as_is software design artifact, and the as_is profile contains no CAN communication design element. Linking this record to an existing design would claim CAN configuration coverage the as_is profile does not have. Recorded as a coverage gap; this is a material one because CAN mailbox configuration gates the diagnostic path that the contactor and voltage safety requirements depend on.

impact_notes.note: The suppressed region performs the CAN1 mailbox control/DMA/parity/EEC/wakeup register writes that decide whether extended-identifier messages are received at all.

CAN reception is the transport for the diagnostic and measurement messages referenced by FB2-SAF-FSR-000001..000003. A silent regression in this vendored block would remove reception without producing any diagnostic event.
The block is marked as generated content but is hand-maintained in the repository with no regeneration marker, diff hook or generation script reference in the record.
Register writes are literal-number based and are bound to one TI Hercules CAN peripheral configuration; the suppression removes the check that would flag a wrong mailbox index.

project_process_evidence.what_it_states: Project-level MUST: 'Code contributed to this project **MUST** be compatible with MISRA C:2012 which is described in :cite:`MISRA-C:2012`.' This is the only occurrence of 'MISRA' in the whole pinned docs/ tree and is the statement every suppression in this record set is a deviation from.

C:015 defines the project's only documented in-source deviation annotation syntax: 'If no assertion can be made for the parameter ... the parameter **MUST** be marked like this at the start of the function context: /* AXIVION Routine Generic-MissingParameterAssert: *ENTITY_NAME*: *RATIONALE* */.' The written guideline therefore mandates the '<ENTITY>: <RATIONALE>' annotation shape for one Axivion check family only; the MisraC2012 style-check family follows the same shape in practice but is not covered by any C:001..C:033 rule.

The project's own C coding guideline is a 33-rule set (C:001..C:033) with an 'Automated Check' column. Only C:002, C:004, C:005, C:006 and C:029 are marked 'Yes'; no rule in the set corresponds to a MisraC2012 style check, so the guideline set does not govern the rules these suppressions waive.

The third-party tool criticality table classifies git, TI ARM CGT, gcc, vs-code, waf, sphinx, ceedling and a custom HIL runner. No static-analysis tool (Axivion, cppcheck or equivalent) is classified, so no tool criticality or qualification basis for the tool that produced these suppressions is recorded in the repository.

corpus_scope.query: graft grep "AXIVION Disable Style MisraC2012" -i (repo root)
corpus_scope.scope_note: This set is 26 deviation records, one per (file, symbol) group, and covers all 43 'AXIVION Disable Style MisraC2012*' annotation lines found under src/ at commit 308028fb. Those 43 annotation lines fall in 20 files, and every one of the 43 is represented in the affected_lines of a record. 26 records cover 43 annotation lines over 26 distinct (file, symbol) groups because, where one symbol carries more than one MisraC2012 rule, the additional Disable lines appear as further entries in the same record's deviations array instead of as separate records. Axivion annotations outside this query are not mined by this set, and their absence must not be read as 'no deviation': 'AXIVION Routine Generic-MissingParameterAssert', 'AXIVION Next Codeline Style MisraC2012*', 'AXIVION Next Codeline Generic-LocalInclude', 'AXIVION Next Codeline CodingStyle-Naming.*', 'AXIVION Next Codeline IISB-LiteralSuffixesCheck', 'AXIVION Next Codeline Generic-NoEllipsis', 'AXIVION Next Codeline Generic-ForbiddenFunctions', 'AXIVION Routine FaultDetection-DivisionByZero', and the 'AXIVION Routine MisraC2012Directive-4.1' / 'AXIVION Routine MisraC2012-2.7' annotations. Non-MISRA families that share one of the 43 mined annotation lines ARE recorded, per record, in tool_reference.co_located_non_misra_checks and in the corresponding deviations entry (for example Generic-NoUnsafeMacro, CertC-PRE01, Generic-NoEmptyLoops, Generic-DoxygenCommentInHeader, Generic-NoMagicNumbers, IISB-LiteralSuffixesCheck); out-of-query suppression sites on the same symbol are likewise listed in the record's deviations array with a note, so that each record's rule exposure is complete for the symbol it names.
